failure_modes.recovery: Re-upload as a new file instead of re-pointing this row.
failure_modes.when: the update tries to move r2_key or source — both are birth facts

description: Edit a spreadsheet file's metadata — title, tags, folder_id, or the AI-analysis fields — without touching the underlying R2 object. r2_key and source are birth facts: including either field in the call at all, even set to its current value, is refused — re-upload as a new file to change custody or provenance. Moving folder_id re-verifies the target folder belongs to your tenant. NEXT: spreadsheet_file_read to confirm the change landed.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: spreadsheet_file_update
